app.title: Velza Iris
app.tagline: Virtual cinematography and camera control for VRChat.
camera.toggle.lookAtMeHelp: Toggle camera automatically aiming at your avatar.
camera.toggle.streamingHelp: Toggle Spout2 direct GPU streaming to OBS.
banner.disconnected: Open VRChat and enable OSC (Action Menu → Options → OSC → Enabled).
banner.closed: Open the camera in VRChat to apply framings or capture positions.
banner.rxUnavailable: UDP listen port 9001 is busy (open-loop mode). Close other OSC apps to enable camera tracking & calibration.
calibrate.title: Calibrate reference anchor
calibrate.help: Bring the camera close to your face looking forward, nudge it slightly and press Calibrate. Lets you reuse framings and sequences in any world.
reset.title: Default values
reset.help: Resets the camera's zoom, exposure, focus, aperture, LookAtMe, speeds and toggles to VRChat's defaults.
home.welcome: Your virtual cinematography studio for VRChat
home.subtitle: Create smooth camera movements simply by positioning your camera and capturing points—no VRC+ or 3D math required.
home.quickStudioTitle: Create a sequence in Iris Studio
home.quickStudioDesc: Position your VRChat camera, capture Point A, Point B, Point C and play back a smooth path right away.
home.quickFramingsDesc: Apply portraits, full-body shots, cinematic angles, orbits and turnaround ref sheets with a single click.
home.step1Desc: Enable OSC in VRChat and open your photo or stream camera.
home.step2Desc: Bring the camera close to your face looking forward and press Calibrate so movements adapt to your location.
home.step3Desc: Use quick framings or jump into Iris Studio to record your own camera paths.
presets.title: Framings
presets.empty: No framings in this category yet.
footer.privacy: No telemetry, no internet: it only communicates locally with VRChat on your PC.
motion.title: Automated motions
motion.needReady: You need a connection, an open camera and a calibrated anchor.
motion.panicHelp: Stops everything immediately and returns to the last static framing.
turnaround.title: Turnaround (ref sheet)
turnaround.help: Circles the avatar and captures photos at each stop, with a green background and no players or environment. Set focus to Manual in VRChat.
studio.config.title: Project settings
studio.config.subtitle: Customize the total duration of your cinematic shot and time display unit.
studio.config.techLimit: Allowed technical range: 0.5 s – 60 min (3600 s)
studio.config.errInvalidNumber: Enter a valid, finite numeric value greater than zero.
studio.config.errSecondsRange: In minutes:seconds (MM:SS) format, seconds must be between 0 and 59.
studio.config.errRange: Duration must be between 0.5 seconds and 60 minutes (3600 seconds).
studio.config.conflictTitle: Elements outside the new time range
studio.config.conflictDesc: Reducing duration to {dur} affects {kf} camera keyframe(s) and {fx} movement/effect clip(s) beyond the new limit. Choose how to proceed:
studio.captureArmed: Waiting for camera movement in VRChat… (Cancel)
studio.captureArmedHint: Nudge your camera slightly in VRChat: we will automatically capture the point as soon as its position arrives.
studio.guideStep1: 1. Place your camera in VRChat where you want to start.
studio.guideStep2: 2. Press 'Capture position' to create Point A.
studio.guideStep3: 3. Move your camera to the next spot and capture Point B.
studio.guideStep4: 4. Add optional effects and press 'Preview' or 'Play in VRChat'.
studio.advancedNotice: This sequence contains advanced Editor adjustments (multi-track effects, per-point optics or target tracking). They are preserved intact and will play back normally.
studio.noSelection: Select a point (A, B, C...) or an effect clip on the timeline to adjust its properties.

community.desc: In upcoming releases you will be able to browse verified .iris packs created by the community (framings, sequences, optical curves and integration with the upcoming VRChat companion asset). Meanwhile, you can freely export and import sequences from the Library tab.

community.step1.title: 1. Relative Presets (Anchor Space)
community.step1.desc: Sequences store offsets relative to your calibrated anchor (world-to-local), allowing the same camera movement to be reused seamlessly in any world after pressing 'Calibrate anchor'.
community.step2.title: 2. No VRC+ Subscription Required
community.step2.desc: Any user can play shared camera sequences via the direct 60 Hz motion engine over /usercamera/Pose without needing VRC+.
community.step3.title: 3. Ready for Companion Asset
community.step3.desc: The SequenceProject schema includes reference space, trajectory scale and TargetProvider metadata ready for the future in-world visualizer prefab in VRChat.
settings.langHelp: Switch all interface labels, tooltips, and effect names between Spanish and English.
settings.companionDesc: Iris Studio strictly separates capabilities verified today via direct OSC from consent-based experimental extensions:
settings.companionCurrent: Verified & viable today: 60 Hz 6DoF capture and playback via /usercamera/Pose, optics (/usercamera/Zoom, Exposure, FocalDistance, Aperture), relative Anchor Space, and calibrated static TargetProvider.
settings.companionFuture: Experimental (Phase 9–10): Avatar OSC prefab and local HTTP Udon bridge (VRCStringDownloader) for in-world trajectory line visualization and voluntary target tracking.
settings.avatarIntegrationDesc: Bidirectional cinematic control via OSC parameters and bone/arrow/camera rig.

effect.dollyIn.desc: Smoothly pushes the camera forward along its line of sight.
effect.dollyOut.desc: Pulls the camera back to reveal more of the scene.
effect.orbit.desc: Orbits partially around the reference anchor or target.
effect.crane.desc: Rises or lowers the camera vertically while maintaining composition.
effect.tilt.desc: Tilts the camera gaze up or down.
effect.reveal.desc: Combines pull-out, lateral slide, and rotation for a dramatic reveal.
effect.microShake.desc: High-frequency subtle vibration to inject energy or tension.
effect.impactShake.desc: Brief impulse jolt with exponential decay for beats or drops.
effect.handheld.desc: Organic handheld camera motion free from robotic stiffness.
effect.cameraDrift.desc: Dreamy, slow floating drift for contemplative and moody shots.
effect.cameraBreathing.desc: Subtle rhythmic oscillation mimicking calm natural breathing.
effect.crashZoom.desc: Snappy rapid optical zoom for music videos and dynamic transitions.
effect.focusPull.desc: Racks focus plane between two distances (requires Manual focus in VRChat).
effect.apertureShift.desc: Gradually shifts aperture to control depth of field and bokeh.
effect.dollyZoom.desc: Pulls back while zooming in to preserve subject framing (Vertigo Effect).
